note: The temperature of the correlative matcher's score peak (pepin.fusion.peak_covariance): one number per matcher, in units of per-beam score (a beam dead on a wall scores 1), with which a candidate one temperature below the winner weighs 1/e. It is the only free scale in a match's covariance and it is calibrated, never chosen. lidar 0.016 was measured on 2026-09-13 by scratch/peak_temperature.py over the four goto tapes of that evening (20260913_184701, 185621, 190024, 190422 on ros/maps/flat3_straight.yaml): 10047 matches off the window's edge, replayed with the node's own tracker settings, each match's pose held against the replay's trace. It is the temperature whose mean NEES is 3.00 (2.99 measured); the per-axis variance of error/sigma there is x 0.45, y 0.34, yaw 1.77, so position comes out conservative by about half a sigma and the heading optimistic, the heading's excess coming from the poor-fit band (fit 0.5-0.6: 1.17 deg actual against 0.65 predicted). At fit >= 0.7 the peak predicts 0.9/1.2 cm and 0.47 deg against an actual 0.72/0.77 cm and 0.40 deg. camera 0.016 is PROVISIONAL: no camera scan is on those tapes (the recorder writes scan/pose/ekf/loc/cmd/costmap/tof and nothing of the fans), so the camera carries the lidar's number until an operator records /localization/measurement against /tracker_pose and runs scratch/peak_temperature.py --camera. Until then the camera's own trust (pepin.sources: 0.5) still widens its answer on top of the peak, as it did on the fit-scaled path.
